threads.body: `wrapt` is pinned as `>=2.2.2` here, but other instrumentation packages pin `wrapt==2.2.2` in their `tests/requirements.latest.txt` (e.g. openai, claude-agent-sdk). Using a loose lower-bound can introduce non-reproducible CI failures if a newer major/minor release breaks compatibility.

threads.body: The module docstring documents `OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=true`, but this env var expects one of the content-capture modes (e.g. `NO_CONTENT`, `SPAN_ONLY`, `EVENT_ONLY`, `SPAN_AND_EVENT`). This is inconsistent with the package README and could mislead users.

threads.body: The sdist include list omits `/examples`. In this repo, instrumentation packages ship example code (manual/ and zero-code/) and include it in sdists (see other instrumentation pyproject.toml files). Without including examples, the published sdist won’t contain them once they’re added.

threads.body: The `instrument_agno` fixture calls `instrumentor.instrument()` directly. The repo’s shared `opentelemetry.test_util_genai.instrumentor.instrument(...)` context manager is the preferred way to drive instrumentation in tests because it sets/restores the GenAI content-capture env var *before* constructing telemetry handlers and reliably cleans up instrumentation.
